description.value: Embarc Vancouver is a Hilton Grand Vacations (formerly Diamond Resorts) vacation ownership resort situated in downtown Vancouver, offering studio and one- and two-bedroom suite accommodations with kitchenettes or full kitchens. The property is steps from Stanley Park, the Seawall, Granville Island, and the Vancouver Art Gallery, making its location appealing to cyclists exploring the city. As a vacation membership product, it is unclear whether the property accepts standard overnight bookings from independent travellers.
